title: Trump Administration Presses Ahead in Legal Battle Over U.S. Attorneys
summary: A judge has ruled that Bill Essayli was acting “unlawfully” as U.S. attorney in Los Angeles. He is one of three prosecutors appointed by the Trump administration through a unique process.
